Chapter 512: Chapter 11: Suggesting Inviting the Galaxy Master Over (Please Subscribe)_3

The so-called basic space model and core space model are nothing but attempts by human Evolvers to understand a certain aspect of the Space Rules through their evolution.

The “Void Interpretation” written by the Moyu Tower Master, on the other hand, interprets the Space Rules from a perspective entirely different from that of humans.

In the Moyu Tower Master’s understanding, everything in the world originates from space, and the many rules, including the Five Elements Rules, Thunderclap Rules, and Light Rules, are all part of the Space Rules.

“Can the Space Rules really be comprehended in this way?”

“Is there really such a side to the Space Rules?”

Lin Yuan suddenly became somewhat obsessed, continuously struck by flashes of insight.

...

And while persistently pondering over the “Void Interpretation,” Lin Yuan’s understanding of the spatial models deepened without cease.

He soon penetrated the six thousandth core space model and was making rapid progress toward the seven thousandth one.

…

Battlefield B0001.

This medium-sized Otherworldly Battlefield is the oldest among all the Battlefields of Different Races, a battleground where human civilization clashed with one of the Peak Clans— the Tianyu Clan.

The Tianyu Clan resembled humans in appearance, their height generally ranging from five to ten meters, except they had pure white wings, which symbolized a clansman’s status and potential in the Tianyu Clan.

For two million years, countless Evolvers from human civilization fought bitterly with the Tianyu Clan, with a ferocity that even surpassed that of the conflicts between human civilization and the Insect Race.

Every day, many human Evolvers perished at the hands of the formidable members of the Tianyu Clan, and likewise, many powerful Tianyu Clan members died at the hands of human civilization’s Evolvers.

At this moment.

On one side of Battlefield B0001, a group of dozens of Eighth Layer Invincible Evolvers gathered, discussing war strategies against the Tianyu Clan.

“In a few years at most, the Tianyu Clan will inevitably launch a full-scale war to determine the ownership of that Star Domain,” the leading short and stout Eighth Layer Invincible said with a solemn tone, speaking slowly.

Human civilization specifically established numerous battlefields to control the impact of war within certain limits as much as possible.

If they fought in the starry sky instead of on the designated battlefields, it would surely result in the destruction of numerous planets.

Even if they won the war, they would only inherit a Star Domain full of scars and desolation.

Previously, Lin Yuan had gone to the Milky Way Star Region to take up the position of Galaxy Master, and the original master of that Star Domain belonged to the Shadow Tribe.

The Shadow Tribe, after losing and conceding defeat in the battlefield conflict with human civilization, voluntarily gave up the control of a Star Domain.

This was also an arrangement agreed upon by the major Peak Clans in the Alliance.

And now.

The clash between human civilization and the Heavenly Race would decide the ownership of a vast Star Domain.

“The Tianyu Clan is well-prepared and determined to win that Star Domain, having mobilized several Eighth Layer Invincibles. Our chances of victory are not great,” a woman clad in blue robes said.

It wasn’t that human civilization was inferior to the Tianyu Clan; rather, sometime earlier, human civilization had deployed a large number of Evolvers to engage in a war with another Peak Clan.

This had led to a shortage of Evolvers available for the current conflict.

“I do have a proposal,” an Eighth Layer Invincible spoke up at that moment.

“Speak,” the short and stout elder said immediately.

He too was concerned about the upcoming war against the Tianyu Clan.

“Not long ago, the Galaxy Master subdued five Eighth Layer Invincible aliens.”

“Repelling three and slaying two, his fame is illustrious.”

The third Eighth Layer Invincible Evolver slowly began:

“Therefore, my proposal is…”

This Eighth Layer Invincible Evolver looked around, “to invite the Galaxy Master here, no matter what the cost.”
